title: Payment
key_points: The payment transaction type allows a client to send XRPL to an address or a regular URI.
It requires a signature from the payer's wallet to be valid.
The 'Account ID' field specifies the recipient of the payment, and the 'Amount' field specifies the amount being sent.
limitations: The source is limited in scope to the XRPL protocol documentation and may not cover all possible use cases or variations.
asserts: The payment transaction type enables users to send funds from one account to another on the XRPL network.
scope: This document asserts the functionality of the payment transaction type within the context of the XRPL protocol. It does not encompass usage in other systems or networks.
